title: London Family Adventure: Pixar, Harry Potter, Minecraft & Dinosaurs
summary: A 2-day family trip in Greater London for two kids aged 7 and 11 who love Pixar movies, Harry Potter books, Minecraft and dinosaurs. The itinerary blends popular sights with taste-matched stops, halal food and convenient prayer breaks.
tips: Use an Oyster card or contactless payment for public transport.
Check mosque websites for updated prayer timings and any women's facilities.
Book Harry Potter studio tour tickets in advance if desired.

stops.address: Cromwell Rd South Kensington, London SW7 5BD United Kingdom
stops.description: Landmark South Kensington museum showcasing the natural world with hands-on exhibits, animatronic dinosaurs, extensive scientific collections, and active research programs.
